thread:
lina: Heads-up: security mandate effective next week 10:00 UTC. All prod database credentials must be migrated to Vault dynamic/short-lived credentials. Static DB user passwords stored in config or secrets manager will be disabled after a 7-day transition window. Please read and act. :rotating_light:

lina: Why: static DB creds have caused a few incidents with leaked config snapshots and slow rotation. Dynamic creds reduce blast radius and allow per-service leases.

maya: Are read-replicas and reporting DBs included? We have some long-running ETL jobs that use static accounts.

lina: Yes, all DBs marked prod, staging-prod, or analytics-prod are in scope. For ETL jobs, use Vault leases with longer TTLs (we'll add a managed role). If you need >24h leases, request an exemption with justification.

aj: Impact to CI/CD and migrations? Some of our migration runners rely on a baked-in DB user.

lina: CI/CD: update runners to fetch short-lived creds at job-start (examples in the migration guide). For one-off migrations you can use a manual short-lived token issued from Vault UI/CLI.

chen: External partners use a few DB users for read-only access. How do we handle partner creds?

lina: Partner access must go through a proxy/service that mints ephemeral credentials per session. If impossible immediately, open an eng-security ticket for a temporary exemption and include access logs and expiry.

lina: Quick checks: Postgres example to list non-Vault users (psql):
```
SELECT usename FROM pg_catalog.pg_user WHERE usename NOT LIKE 'vault_%';
```
MySQL example: `SELECT User, Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User NOT LIKE 'vault_%';`

maya: Migration playbook?

lina: Short playbook: 1) instrument app to request DB creds from Vault via role {app-name}. 2) update secrets in CI/CD to call Vault at job start. 3) smoke test writes/reads. 4) mark original secret rotated and schedule deletion after 48h. Migration doc: https://internal.redwood/security/db-vault-migrate

infra-oncall-bot: Note: automated audit will run at enforcement time and create eng-security tickets for noncompliant DB secrets.

aj: When exactly is enforcement?

lina: Enforcement start: 2024-11-26T10:00:00Z. Transition window ends 2024-12-03T10:00:00Z; after that old credentials will be disabled.

ops-bot: deploy security/db-vault-roles -> canary success 09:45 UTC :white_check_mark:

chen: We have a handful of legacy reporting VMs that load config files from disk. Will there be a helper to rotate files in-place?

lina: We're adding a lightweight agent and a helper script to inject creds at boot and rotate tokens. Agent binary and docs will be posted to the migration doc by EOD.

lina: If you need help: 1) open an eng-security ticket with "db-vault-migration" prefix, 2) tag infra-oncall, and 3) include service name and current secret location. We'll prioritize critical-path services for hands-on assistance.

maya: Thanks, starting inventory of DB users now.

aj: I'll schedule a platform-auth office hour tomorrow to help teams migrate.

infra-oncall-bot: Initial scan flagged 18 DB secrets stored as static credentials. Tickets created: https://internal.redwood/engsec/tickets/RED-4480

lina: Closing thread: we'll post the final runbook and agent link to the ticket. Migration window reminder will be posted 48h before enforcement.
